chunks: Al-Khasa'is: Ibn al-Walid, from al-Saffar, from al-Barqi, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Jamil, from Zurara, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: The religion is supported by four: by a knowledgeable person who speaks out and utilizes his knowledge, and by a rich person who is not miserly with his bounty upon the people of the religion of Allah, and by a poor person who does not sell his hereafter for his world, and by an ignorant person who is not too arrogant to seek knowledge. So when the knowledgeable hides his knowledge, and the rich is miserly with his wealth, and the poor sells his hereafter for his world, and the ignorant is too arrogant to seek knowledge, the world will recede backwards retracing its steps. So let not the multitude of mosques and the multitudes of different nations deceive you. It was said: O Commander of the Faithful, how should one live in that age? He said: Mingle with them outwardly and oppose them inwardly. It will be for a man what he has earned, and he will be with the one he loves, and wait with that for the relief from Allah.

key_terms.عَالِمٍ نَاطِقٍ: A knowledgeable person who speaks out

ai.seo_question: What are the four pillars supporting the stability of religion according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates from Imam Ali (peace be upon him) that the stability of religion depends on four types of people: a knowledgeable scholar, a generous rich person, a content poor person, and a humble seeker of knowledge. When these four fail in their roles, the world regresses, and believers are instructed to maintain outward conformity while preserving inner faith, awaiting divine relief.

en.ammaar-muslim: 7. [7/34] al-Khisal: Ibn al-Walid from al-Saffar from al-Barqi from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil from Zurara from Abi Ja’far عليه السلام who said:

the commander of the faithful عليه السلام said: the religion is supported by four: by the knowledgeable person who speaks out and uses it (his knowledge), and by the rich person who is not miserly with his bounty (spending it) on the people of the religion of Allāh, and by the poor person who does not sell off his hereafter for his world, and by the ignorant person who is not too arrogant to seek knowledge, so when it happens that the knowledgeable hides his knowledge, and the rich is miserly with his wealth, and the poor sells off his hereafter for his world, and the ignorant is too arrogant to seek knowledge – the world will recede backwards retracing its steps, so the great number of mosques (at that time) and the multitudes of different nations (who pray in them) should not deceive you, it was said: O commander of the faithful – how should one live in that age? He said: mingle with them outwardly and oppose them inwardly, it will be for a man what he has earned, and he will be with the one he loves, and wait with that for the relief from Allāh.
